Photo 1 shows the same TV screen with a 'NEW 2025 Hisense' label in the top-left corner. The screen content is identical to photo 0.

The screen overlay in photo 0 mentions 'VOICE SMART TV' and 'AI Sports Mode' but does not mention 'Quantum Processor 4K'. This feature is not visible in the photos.
